entities.summary: Persian, a notable figure in the history of Iraq, associated with Babylonian and Assyrian Empires (626 BCE–539 BCE). Preceded by Neo-Assyrian Empire and Amorite. Their legacy influenced Fall of Nineveh to the Medes and Babylonians and Nebuchadnezzar II destroys Jerusalem and deports Jews to Babylon.
